10004.lore: I'm not going to lie, life's been a little rough. I was on a tear playin' the couriers in White Spire, when all of a sudden I hit a cold streak. It happens. We figure we were due for a win so we go to Momma Eeb and take out a marker. Based on past dealings, Eeb's not too keen to let us borrow the money so we give her Meepo 3 as a collateral. We go back to the track, and well- look, I can't stress enough how cold the couriers were that day. We have a team meeting and decide it's not fair that Meepo 3 gets his legs broken because a sure thing fell through. So I go the Jasper Circle and get a loan to pay Eeb and get Meepo 3 back. But now we're in it with the Jasper Circle so we really don't want to take any chances because Momma Eeb will mess you up, Lasan will straight up kill ya. So we decide to do some odd jobs for the Ravenhooks and skim enough money off the top to be able to pay back the Jasper Circle, but that's when I realize that there's no way we could get cleaned out 3 times in a row... you're smart people, I think you can figure out where this is going. So mistakes were made and now we're back to where we started with the Jasper Circle debt only this time the Ravenhooks won't take us back because, ya know, we robbed them. We're freaking out and pointing fingers, and that's when Meepo 3 sees a wanted poster for our old friend Mireska. Now Lord Sunbreeze has put a huge bounty on his daughter that would cover the Jasper debt in spades, but A: Mireska's a friend... and more importantly B: there was no way we'd get to her before Gondar did. So I come up with a new plan. Gondar will capture Mireska. We'll free Mireska. Mireska will owe us. And Mireska will keep the Jasper Circle from killing us. It's a perfect plan. What could go wrong? — Meepo, Petty Con Man

10005.name: Divided We Stand
10005.lore: I think it's important to have friends that can compensate for your weakness. For instance, I'm great at playing cards; whereas Meepo 2 is more of a dice guy. Does that mean we all get along? Of course not, one of us is always getting the rest of us in trouble... but at the end of the day, we always work together to find a way out... because if you can't count on yourselves... who can you count on? — Meepo, Team of Grifters

10006.name: Luna
10006.text: [abilityname[Lucent Beam]][color:play_effect[[g:616[Round Start]]:]]  Deal 1 [g:509[piercing]] damage to a random enemy and add a charge to your [[Eclipse]] cards.
10006.text_plain:

Round Start: Deal 1 piercing damage to a random enemy and add a charge to your Eclipse cards.
10006.lore: Once I was like Sorla Khan... a warlord that did as she pleased. Strong and immortal I knew that no man or beast was my equal... until my hubris cost me everything. It was there at my lowest that Selemene found me. Tested me. And showed me the moon lit path. Much time has passed since that day, and I find purpose and pride in protecting the Nightsilver Woods with other members of the Dark Moon. But word has spread of Sorla Khan's march, and while we have never met I understand her all too well. And so I travel to Roseleaf to defeat her, and save her from herself. — Luna, the Moon Rider

10010.lore: Writers block. It is an awful condition that can ensure even the most prolific of authors. Once the words used to flow freely from my lips to my scribe Thrael's ears...but lately I have been... distracted by the pulp drivel Goodkind unleashes into the world. I had no idea that the adventures of a monosyllabic red thug could capture so many readers, yet if I am to be honest my own works feel boring in comparison... its vexing. Ah well, I guess it's time to find Goodkind and eat her. — Auroth, the Winter Wyvern

10014.lore: My father was good man. A regent over the lands of Slom, he ruled the small folk with fairness and justice. My mother was the picture of patience and compassion, a woman beloved by her people as if they were her children. And my siblings? Gods we were trouble. I remember the day we found Father's collection of ancient maps, Tressa thought it would be funny if we- it doesn't matter now. They're all dead. — Banehallow, the Lycan

10016.lore: As a child I was baptized in the Font of Avernus...its black mist embracing me...enveloping me... becoming one with me. As a man I have wielded its power to defend the House of Avernus, and build a legacy that will never be forgotten. But rumors have reached my ears.... rumors that indicate that my familial font is not the only source of the mist... if this is true I must find it and consume it. For its blessings must remain mine alone. — Abaddon, the Lord of Avernus

Such a woman will be a powerful convert to the Knights of the Fold. And once I have shown her the true light of god... she will bring her followers to me. — Chen, Holy Knight of the Fold

But when such a gift is bestowed upon you, it is right to give thanks... and there is only one way to show gratitude to the Flayed Twins. With blood. — Strygwyr, the Bloodseeker

10020.lore: Axe is a man of many talents. Well one talent. The murder talent. However that seems to be enough for Axe to attract a legion of devoted fans that follow his adventures. It also probably helps that Axe's bard, Goodkind is good at what she calls 'embellishment'. Axe is unsure what the word means, but it's probably a good thing. — Axe, Adventurer and Murder Machine

That's not a tranquil jungle... that's a sleeping army. And unless we are prepared when that forest starts to march it will be the end of everybody. — Rizzrack, the Timbersaw

10025.lore: The idea of working with Mazzie is...less exciting to me. But Sniper has raised some excellent points: The keen have been divided for too long and at least he doesn't yell at trees. Still, it's hard for me to overlook our past. Do I think we'll be friends? No. Do I think I can stomach his presence and not 'accidently' shoot in him the back of the head? Maybe if I drink enough. Time will tell. — Boush, the Tinker

10026.name: Rix
10026.text:
[abilityname[Relentless Rebel]][color:death_effect[[g:603[Death Effect]]:]] [g:417[Gain]] +2 [color:attribute_glyph[▣]] permanently. [g:417[Give]] {s:thisCardName} [g:611[Rapid Deployment]].

10026.lore: I was conscripted to the Bronze Legion when I was a pup. They marched through my village with their shiny armor and promises of glory and I couldn't sign on fast enough. I smiled when they put the conscript mark on my arm cause I knew that if I worked hard enough, if I followed orders, if I showed valor and skill in battle I would make something of myself and become more than just a stupid savage from redmaw. And so I followed. And fought. And killed. And with every town we occupied, every insurrection we quelled, every voice of dissent I silenced, the words 'for the glory of Stonehall' grew hollower, and that bronzed mark I took pride in became heavier. So now we march through Roseleaf to intercept the Red Mist Horde, and again my Commander has asked me to 'speak to my savage people'... well speak to them I shall... and when I do, they'll understand that I will fight beside them until every soldier is sent back to Stonehall in a bronzed coffin. — Rix, Leader of the Vhoul Rebellion

10028.lore: Once Pugna used me. Controlled me. Owned me. Eventually I escaped, and while at first I relished in my newfound freedom, as years passed it became a more hollow existence... for a while I thought this ennui came because my tormentor still roamed free, and I wouldn't find peace until I make him suffer as I did. But after I began my quest for vengeance I came to a realization. Pugna is not an abnormality. How many dabble in magic to summon and control. To create life then force it to obey. No. Pugna's enslavement won't bring me peace... but enslaving every wizard? Now that is something that will help me sleep well at night. — Viper, the Netherdrake

The only question that remains is how many centaurs will I have to kill before they realize Roseleaf Forest is no longer their hunting grounds. — Karroch, the Beastmaster

10032.name: Drow Ranger
10032.text: [abilityname[Precision Aura]][color:play_effect[[g:615[Aura]]:]]  {s:thisCardName}'s allies in all lanes have +1 [color:attribute_glyph[▣]].  [color:quick[[g:624[Cross Lane]]]]

10032.lore: Power is a funny thing. It's something we all want but are taught to be ashamed to seek. But power is neither good nor evil. It's freedom. It's the ability to live the life you choose, on the terms that you want. People like to criticize where that power came from but in time, history forgets... and only remembers what you chose to do with it. People can judge me for helping Kanna. But in time they will understand. — Traxex, the Drow Ranger

10033.name: Earthshaker
10033.text:
[abilityname[Fissure]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active 3 ■, 1 Mana:]] [g:410[Bounce]] allies from {s:thisCardName} to a slot in this lane within range 3, then [g:409[summon]] [[Rocks]] in their place.]]

10033.lore: My existence shouldn't be. I was not born of a mother, but from a rock...and yet I was carved by no artisan. No... I willed my consciousness into being. For so long, I walked alone... confused... but that all changed when I met Kanna. I was rudderless, and she gave me direction. I was ignorant of the ways of man, and she gave me understanding. I was alone in this world, and she gave me companionship. But above all, she gave me a name and sense of self. Once I called myself Raigor Stonehoof...but she has given me a new name that is far more fitting...Earthshaker. — Earthshaker, Adopted Son

10036.lore: Rix. Tresdin. Sorla Khan. You ask any one of them and they will spin you a story about why their cause is just; and every single one of them is wrong. This war is senseless, its cost will be immeasurable, and the only people who will profit are the future historians who'll sell books about the massacre. I can't stop this war from happening... but I will do whatever I can to minimize the damage. — Aiustha, the Enchantress

10038.name: Lich
10038.text: [abilityname[Sacrifice]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active 2 ■, 1 Mana:]] [g:412[Slay]] another ally and draw a card. Restore 2 [g:513[Mana]].]]

The Vhoul are losing their battle against The Bronze Legion and are willing to do anything for victory... and the Crystal Maiden of Icewrack happens to be on holiday. It truly is an embarrassment of riches. The only lingering question is who should I kill first. — Ethreain, the Lich

10043.lore:
'It's not easy being the smartest ogre in the world. There's lots of jealous people out there.'
'Think about how many people you know with one head.'
'I bet it's a lot.'
'Now realize that every single one of them is half as smart as us. Do you know how lonely it is to walk this earth, never finding an intellectual eq-'
'WE LIKE ROCKS!'
'Yes...yes we do.' — Aggron Stonebreak, the Ogre Magi

10044.name: Omniknight
10044.text: [abilityname[Purification]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active 2 ■, 1 Mana:]] Heal an ally 3 and deal 1 [g:509[piercing]] damage to each of its [g:600[adjacent enemies]].]]
10044.text_plain:
Purification
Active 2, 1 Mana: Heal an ally 3 and deal 1 piercing damage to each of its adjacent enemies.
10044.lore: Something is stirring in Roseleaf. I'm not referring to Stonehall's war machine, or the Red Mist Horde... no... those are problems of flesh and blood, distractions keeping attention divided from the real danger. The Court of Ristul. But I cannot face this danger alone, and so I hope to meet with Luna of the Dark Moon. With the combined might of Selemene and the All Seeing One, we may have a chance. — Omniknight, Devoted to the Allseeing One

10047.name: Phantom Assassin
10047.text_plain:
Efficient Killer
Double Phantom Assassin's damage when striking a hero.
10047.lore: The Veiled Sisterhood gave me everything. My life. My skills. My family... My very purpose. So when the Veiled Oracles provide me a list of names, I never question what it is I need to do. — Mortred, the Phantom Assassin

10048.name: Pugna
10048.text: [abilityname[Nether Ward]]When your opponent plays a non-[g:5[item]] card from this lane, deal 1 [g:509[piercing]] damage to their [g:2[tower]] and [g:411[burn]] 1 of their [g:513[mana]].

10048.lore: The Tyler Estate. It seeks to control magic. Punish those that violate rules set by the Quorum. But I will show them that some things cannot be controlled. And when the Tyler Estate Burns, I will set my sights on Weeping Rose itself. — Pugna, Ill-Tempered Nihilist

10050.name: Sniper
10050.text: [abilityname[Headshot]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active 3 ■, 1 Mana:]] Deal 4 damage to another [g:608[unit]] within range 5.  [color:quick[[g:624[Cross Lane]]]]]]
10050.text_plain:
Headshot
Active 3, 1 Mana: Deal 4 damage to another unit within range 5. Cross Lane
10050.lore: For too long the Keenfolk have been fractured. Little colonies spread across the world each coveting their own research... but as we kept to our workshops the world around us changed. Stonehall rose to power. The nation of Revtel was born. The Quroum of Weeping Rose grew bolder... and what did we do? We toiled and tinkered. We built wondrous machines and used them for petty tasks. This cannot continue. The Keenfolk clans need to unite, and show the world what we're capable of. — Kardel, the Sniper

10052.name: Mazzie
10052.text:
[g:5[Item]] Slots 2.

Item Slots 2.

Mazzie has +1 Attack, +1 Armor, and +1 Health for each equipped item.
10052.lore: So there I was: drinking with my friends, well actually I was drinking alone but I was thinking about my friends so it's basically the same thing. Anyway. Sniper walks into my workshop and is like 'Mazzie, you're wasting your life' and I'm like 'Geeze Sniper, if I wanted to feel bad about myself I'd ask my parents why they never visit me on my birthday' but Sniper's not interested in hearing about parental abandonment, he's interested in uniting the Keenfolk clans. So I say I'll help: on the condition that I get to give our group a cool name. Sniper rolled his eyes and sighed, which is basically the same thing as a yes, and THAT'S how the Society of Likeminded Keenfolk was born. — Mazzie, Founding Member of the Society of Likeminded Keenfolk

10053.name: Prellex
10053.text:
[abilityname[Gather the Faithful]][g:409[Summon]] [[Mega Creeps]] instead of [[Melee Creeps]].

Gather the Faithful

10053.lore: Brothers and sisters, The Ancient is coming. With every passing day my visions grow stronger: A violet sky. A sundered moon. And an Ancient voice that whispers 'Prepare for my arrival.' Prepare. Such a simple word that does no justice to the work that lies before us... We must be heralds; walking testimonies to the benevolence of The Ancient. Spreading the word of its glorious arrival, no matter if that message is received with joy or scorn. We must be architects; building not just this monastery for those who believe what I have seen, but an entire world that is worthy of the Ancient's splendor. We must be zealots; willing to lay down our lives in defense of this sacred space, because rest assured we are at war. Kanna and her heretics will stop at nothing to undo the work that we've accomplished, and that is why we must return in kind. — Prellex, Priestess of the Radiant

10054.lore: I've given myself to the Vigil Knights. I will train with them. Learn their ways. Become the best... and ultimately: destroy them from within. — Sven, Knight of the Vigil

Branches of Iron

10056.lore: My feelings on the war in roseleaf are... complicated. Neither the bronze legion nor the red mist are threats to my people, and yet my cousins willingly intercede on the Vhoul's behalf. Their fondness for such frail creatures is strange to me, but none the less they call for my aid, and I am compelled to answer. — Rooftrellen, the Treant Protector

10058.name: Sorla Khan
10058.text_plain:
Warmonger
Pillager

+2 damage when striking a tower.
10058.lore: I'm not oblivious to my reputation. I won't even pretend that it's un-earned. I've lead the Red Mist from town to town taking whatever it is we want... and what we want is to survive. So yes. I am a warlord. I have done and will do unspeakable things. But make no mistake, I am no conqueror. I am the Savior of the Oglodi. It's just an unfortunate reality that my people's salvation means your people's destruction. — Sorla, Khan of the Red Mist

10062.name: Skywrath Mage
10062.text:
[abilityname[Concussive Shot]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active 2 ■, 1 Mana:]] [g:417[Give]] an enemy and its [g:601[neighbors]] -3 [color:attribute_glyph[▤]].

10062.lore: I empathize with Rix. It's not easy following the orders of a leader you despise. But I don't have the luxury of staging a rebellion...the stakes are too high, and so I must bide my time... and wait to be reunited with my beloved. — Dragonus, the Skywrath Mage

10063.name: Mystic Flare
10063.text: Deal 6 [g:509[piercing]] damage evenly divided among an enemy and its [g:601[neighbors]].
10063.text_plain: Deal 6 piercing damage evenly divided among an enemy and its neighbors.
10063.lore: I dedicated my life to the pursuit of the mystic arts...But while my head was buried in books, my beloved was betrayed and cast out of the Ghastly Eyrie. I was unable to save her then... but at least I have the power to save her now. — Skywrath Mage, Guilt-Wrecked

10064.name: Crystal Maiden
10064.text:
[abilityname[Arcane Aura]]When you play a [g:4[spell]] or [g:3[enchantment]] from any lane, restore 2 [color:attribute_glyph[]] [g:513[Mana]].

10064.lore: 'Warden of Icewrack.' It's a fancy title. In theory it means I'm responsible for maintaining law and order, collaborating with the Sapphire Conclave on magical crimes, and protecting the weak from all manners of nasty things. In practice I help farmers fix fences. So I decided to go on a little sabbatical. Besides... I couldn't stay in Icewrack. It's cold. It's boring. And I heard my sister was planning on visiting so I definitely had to get the hell outta there. — Rylai, the Crystal Maiden

10065.name: Zeus
10065.lore: I care little for the affairs of mortals. I have no stake in the war between the Red Mist and the Bronze Legion, and the plight of the Vhoul does little to stir my blood. What I DO care about however, is that charlatan Storm Spirit claiming my lightning as his own... and so I travel to Roseleaf; to prove that there is no god of lightning above me. — Zeus, Lord of Heaven

10067.name: Magnus

10067.lore: I'm no stranger to man's lust for conquest. To be seen not as a person but as a commodity... and I refuse to stand idly by while the Vhoul are subjugated. It's too late for my people... but it might not be too late for theirs. — Magnus, Endangered Protector

10068.name: Dark Seer
10068.text:
[abilityname[Vacuum]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active 3 ■, 1 Mana:]] Choose a slot. Deal 1 damage to enemies in lane then pull them towards the target slot.

[color:quick[[g:604[▢ Quickcast]]]]]]

Vacuum

10068.lore: The Red Mist slowly marches to Stonehall. The Bronze Legion plans an ambush in Roseleaf. But the denizens of that Vhoul city do not take kindly to occupation and have sparked an insurrection. Three factions. One battlefield. And not a strategic mind between them. I will defeat these charlatans of war. And in doing so, prove my brilliance. — Ish'kafel, the Dark Seer

10069.name: Legion Commander
10069.text: [abilityname[Moment of Courage]]Whenever {s:thisCardName} [g:423[strikes]] a [g:608[unit]] and survives, heal {s:thisCardName} 3.
10069.text_plain:
Moment of Courage
Whenever Legion Commander strikes a unit and survives, heal Legion Commander 3.
10069.lore: I know these people think me a monster. I don't blame them. No one wants to be occupied, but it's in their best interests! If we weren't here in Roseleaf the Red Mist would have slaughtered them all... today the Vhoul see us as villains, but after we defeat Sorla Khan... The Bronze Legion will be heralded as the heroes we are. — Tresdin, Legion Commander

10070.name: Ursa
10070.text: [abilityname[Fury Swipes]]Whenever {s:thisCardName} deals [g:610[physical damage]] to a [g:608[unit]], [g:417[give]] it -1 [color:attribute_glyph[▤]] permanently.
10070.text_plain:
Fury Swipes
Whenever Ursa deals physical damage to a unit, give it -1 Armor permanently.
10070.lore: This isn't my fight. But if I don't stand with the Vhoul it's only a matter of time before the Bronze Legion comes for my people. A message needs to be sent... and it will be bloody. — Ursa, Tribal Protector

10076.name: Smeevil Armsmaster
10076.text: Whenever one of your units deals [g:610[physical damage]] to an enemy, [g:417[give]] it +1 [color:attribute_glyph[▣]] permanently.
10076.text_plain: Whenever one of your units deals physical damage to an enemy, give it +1 Attack permanently.
10076.lore: Greevils were terrible mistake. Smeevils were created to fix mistake. Greevils hurt. Smeevils help. For instance. I make swords that can be used to kill Greevils. And other people. But ideally Greevils. — Kareth, Smeevil Armsmaster

10077.text: Whenever an ally dies, [g:409[summon]] an [[Eidolon]] and remove a charge.
10077.text_plain: Whenever an ally dies, summon an Eidolon and remove a charge.
10077.lore: My role is not to question, but to act. It doesn't matter if you are a pauper in the street, a king on a throne, or a mad wizard locked away in the Tyler Estate. If your name is given to me by The Veiled Sisters... your death is inevitable. The only question is when will I choose to take it. — Hetheel, Sister of the Veil
effects: Whenever an ally dies, [g:409[summon]] an [[Eidolon]] and remove a charge.

10078.name: Tyler Estate Censor
10078.text: Whenever opponent plays a card from this lane, [g:411[burn]] 1 of their remaining [g:513[Mana]].
10078.text_plain: Whenever opponent plays a card from this lane, burn 1 of their remaining Mana.
10078.lore: There is no such thing as forbidden magic in Weeping Rose. But some mistake the Quorums...open mindedness... as a license to be irresponsible. The Tyler Estate is what awaits those who would abuse the hospitality Weeping Rose provides. — Votajo, Tyler Estate Censor
effects: Whenever opponent plays a card from this lane, [g:411[burn]] 1 of their remaining [g:513[Mana]].

10079.name: Smeevil Blacksmith
10079.text: Whenever an ally enters this lane, [g:417[give]] it +1 [color:attribute_glyph[▤]] permanently.

10079.lore: My needs are simple. A hammer. An anvil. And a master who appreciates my skill. The first two are easy to come by. The third is more elusive. Fortunately bad masters have a tendency to die in battle. Some say this is because of flaws in their armor. I say...'prove it?' — Vareth, Smeevil Blacksmith

10080.name: Rebel Decoy
10080.text_plain: Active 1, 1 Mana: Swap Rebel Decoy with an ally.
10080.lore: I'll never forget the day I met Rix. It was in the early days of the revolution, when people were scared to even gather at night. We met in the tailor's wine cellar and Rix talked... god did he talk. Of passion. Of mistakes. Of his love for our people. I was mesmerized. We all were. So when he turned to me and asked what I could give to help the rebellion, there was only one answer... 'My life.' — Lyla, Rebel Decoy

10082.name: Centaur Poacher
10082.text: [color:play_effect[[g:602[Play Effect]]:]]  Repeat twice, deal 1 damage to a random enemy with the lowest [g:511[health]].

10083.name: Pit Fighter of Quoidge
10083.text_plain:
Devour

Whenever a neighbor dies, gain +3 Attack permanently.
10083.lore: I get it, I get it, 'The Fields of Endless Carnage' sounds like a horrible place to take a holiday but I'm tellin' you Quoidge is a great city filled with lovely people. If you ever make the trip be sure to stop by the fightin' pits and say hello. I may look different on account of the whole sewing-on-limbs thing but I'll remember you... I never forget a face. — Tristan, Undead Boxer and all around swell chap

10085.name: Assassin's Shadow
10085.lore: For the most powerful of our order... not even death removes us from our sacred duty. Our communion with the Phantom Veil is strong enough to let our spirit live on, long after our bodies have rot. The mortal coil is now behind me, and the presence of my sisters, while comforting, is a distraction from the work I must do. My list still has names on it...and I won't rest until they are dead. — Elsbeth, the Assassin's Shadow

10086.name: Disciple of Nevermore
10086.text_plain: Aura: Disciple of Nevermore's allies have +1 Attack and -1 Armor.
10086.lore: There is delicious conflict here. And where there is conflict there is desperation. And where there is desperation there is blood to be shed and deals to be made. — Zo, Disciple of Nevermore

10087.name: Legion Standard Bearer
10087.lore: As a boy I dreamed of being a member of the Stonehall Elite... to be trained by Belasanno himself in the ways of war... but the sad truth is that I have no gift for combat. I am no soldier. But I am a believer. In our emperor. In our country. In our mission. I may not be a swordsman, but I am proud to carry the bullsnake into battle. — Pololo, Standard Bearer of the Bronze Legion

10090.name: Relentless Zombie
10090.text: [color:death_effect[[g:603[Death Effect]]:]]  [g:409[Summon]] a [[Zombie]] into the closest slot.
10090.text_plain: Death Effect: Summon a Zombie into the closest slot.
10090.lore: The dead are rising in Roseleaf, Knogh...someone took The Oath. — Vanessa, Heretic for Hire
effects: [color:death_effect[[g:603[Death Effect]]:]]  [g:409[Summon]] a [[Zombie]] into the closest slot.

10091.lore: These are strange times in Revtel. Iron Fog is terrorized by Losel. The Veiled Sisters assassinated Kwerthias. And Lord Sunbreeze's own daughter has burned down his estate. But despite the setbacks, the wheel continues to turn and profits continue to roll in. But there is no time to mourn in Revtel... there is business to be done. — Lowenplatt, Merchant of Revtel

10092.name: Oglodi Vandal

[g:521[Pillager]]

10092.lore: Besiege Stonehall. I've seen Khan's over thrown for even suggesting it. But when Sorla gave the order, not one of us batted an eye. Not because she's the strongest. Not because we fear her cruelty. But because we knew that she would die before she failed her people. And so The Red Mist marches... and may the gods have mercy on whoever stands in our way. — Seguri, Red Mist Vandal
effects:
[g:521[Pillager]]

10094.name: Mercenary Exiles
10094.text: [activatedability[[color:ability[Active 2 ■, 1 Mana:]] Spend all your gold. {s:thisCardName} [g:417[gains]] [color:attribute_glyph[▣]] and [color:attribute_glyph[▥]] permanently equal to half the gold spent.]]
10094.text_plain: Active 2, 1 Mana: Spend all your gold. Mercenary Exiles gains Attack and Health permanently equal to half the gold spent.
10094.lore: We were good soldiers that served Galanius and the Bronze Legion for years. The blood we spilt didn't just bring glory to Stonehall, it helped build the whole damn empire. And how were we rewarded? With a fancy piece of red cloth to wear into battle. But you can't build a keep out of honor. You can't feed your family with Pride. You can't repay a debt with Glory. So now we fight for the only thing that matters. Gold. — Tessgan, leader of the Black Hilt Mercenary Company

10095.name: Keenfolk Golem
10095.text: [color:play_effect[[g:602[Play Effect]]:]]  Discard 4 random non-[g:5[item]] cards. [g:417[Give]] {s:thisCardName} +1[color:attribute_glyph[▣]]/+1[color:attribute_glyph[▥]] permanently for each card discarded.
10095.text_plain: Play Effect: Discard 4 random non-item cards. Give Keenfolk Golem +1 Attack/+1 Health permanently for each card discarded.
10095.lore: Mazzie is horrible at lots of things. Being dependable. Staying sober. Keeping secrets. But I'll give him credit: he knows how to build a giant robot. — Tinker, Humbled Inventor

10096.name: Emissary of the Quorum
10096.text_plain: Active 1, 1 Mana: Give other allies +2 Attack/+2 Health permanently.
10096.lore: The more judgmental call Weeping Rose a place where magic is unfettered by morality... a chaotic city of delights and horrors. And they would be partially right. The city was founded on the idea that 'good magic' and 'evil magic' are labels created by lesser minds... But there is no chaos in Weeping Rose... The Quorum ensures that is the case. And it is on their behalf that I have traveled here. — The Emissary of the Quorum

10097.name: Marrowfell Brawler
10097.text:
Whenever {s:thisCardName} deals [g:610[physical damage]] to a [g:608[unit]], [g:417[give]] it -1 [color:attribute_glyph[▣]] until it dies.

[color:play_effect[[g:602[Play Effect]]:]] {s:thisCardName} [g:400[battles]] the enemy blocking it twice.

Whenever Marrowfell Brawler deals physical damage to a unit, give it -1 Attack until it dies.

Play Effect: Marrowfell Brawler battles the enemy blocking it twice.
10097.lore: Every year my clan comes to Roseleaf for the Thunderhide migration... and while the denizens of Roseleaf were a minor nuisance we never bothered to hunt them... they were too frail to make a worthy trophy. But now things have changed. This 'Rix' has stirred their blood and now they fancy themselves warriors... perhaps it's time to start a new hunt. — Mavor, Marrowfell Brawler

10102.name: Thunderhide Pack
10102.lore: When hunting Thunderhides, you always come home with new scars...if you come home at all. — Warrunner warns his hunters

10103.name: Ogre Corpse Tosser
10103.text: Whenever an ally dies, deal 1 [g:509[piercing]] damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]].
10103.text_plain: Whenever an ally dies, deal 1 piercing damage to the enemy tower.
10103.lore: Friends said throwing dead bodies was hobby, not real job. Who's laughing now? Not friends. I kill them for not supporting my dream. — Lommett, Ogre Corpse Tosser
effects: Whenever an ally dies, deal 1 [g:509[piercing]] damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]].

10104.name: Bronze Legionnaire
10104.lore: The Red Mist Horde is on the march, looting and destroying every city that stands between them and our great capital of Stonehall. If we wish to protect our home...if we wish to stop these monsters... we must be willing to do whatever it takes. — Decius, Bronze Legionnaire

10107.name: Vhoul Martyr
10107.text_plain: Death Effect: Give Vhoul Martyr's allies +1 Attack/+1 Health permanently.
10107.lore: I knew this day would come the moment I agreed to host Rix's gatherings in my wine cellar... but I wasn't ready for what it felt like to be pulled from my home in the middle of the night. I know it's only a matter of time before Tresdin has me executed, and I won't lie. I'm scared. But we all have our parts to play. — Papa Samet, Vhoul Martyr

10108.name: Thunderhide Alpha
10108.lore: The Alpha is a fearsome beast, capable of untold destruction... only the strongest of centaurs dare to stand in its presence, let alone fight it one on one. — Warrunner on the trail of the Alpha

10111.name: Satyr Duelist

10127.lore: The Bronze Legion brings peace, the stupid Vhoul bring chaos. Like Rix I joined the Legion. Unlike Rix I'm loyal. Soon the rebellion will be finished, perhaps then Commander Tresdin will let me eat Vhoul. — Tox Armripper, Bronze Legion Conscript

10129.lore: The Revtel campaign was successful, but I was only there to observe, not take part... they say I'm not ready to kill on my own... but I'll prove them wrong. — Myrian, the Assassin's Apprentice

10212.name: Blade of the Vigil
10212.lore: The Knights of the Vigil were renowned for their skill in battle. The stories of Sven, Geeta the Wildblade, and Klemens have captured the imagination of so many... you can't throw a rock in the Gardens of Freth without hitting a group of school kids recreating their adventures. But playing a knight is easy... wielding one of their swords is far more challenging. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10215.name: Broadsword
10215.lore: Perfect for the warrior on a budget. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10220.name: Ring of Tarrasque
10220.lore: Some say this ring can let it's bearer live forever. Naturally that's an exaggeration, a Tarrasque itself isn't an immortal creature, though it does make you wonder... if this ring is fashioned out of bone and muscle, what could someone do with a Tarrasque's heart? — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10222.name: Bracers of Sacrifice
10222.text:
+1 [color:attribute_glyph[▤]]

[activatedability[[color:ability[Active 2 ■, 1 Mana:]] [g:412[Slay]] this [g:0[hero]] and deal 4 damage to [g:600[adjacent enemies]].]]

10222.lore: In Xhacatocatl, High Priests don these bracers when preparing to make an offering to the Flayed Twins. So devout are the priests in their faith, that if a suitable sacrifice can not be found to please The Twins, they are willing to offer themselves instead. Well, "willing" is relative, some try to make a run for it and are tied down screaming, but generally they're all on board. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10223.name: Red Mist Maul
10223.lore: Long ago, the Oglodi capital was a shining beacon of art and philosophy... and then they met the Tarnsmen. A barbarous group of demon worshipers, the Tarns lay siege to the Oglodi's great city, sating their bloodlust on any they could find. It was a massacre. The battle ended, only because the Tarns grew bored... and left a great civilization in ashes. Ever a resilient people, the Oglodi rebuilt and started again... referring to the razing of their capital as 'The Bleak Day'. But for some rebuilding was not enough. They believed that forsaking the martial in favor of the esoteric is what led to their down fall... and so they left and formed the first Red Mist Horde. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10224.name: Helm of the Dominator
10224.text_plain:
+2 Armor

Active 2, 1 Mana: Steal an enemy creep.
10224.lore: It takes the blackest of hearts to be willing to bend the wills of men. Or you could be Chen. Chen does it all the time. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10225.name: Vesture of the Tyrant
10225.text_plain:

Your tower has +3 Armor.
10225.lore: To say Galanius is a polarizing figure is an understatement. The Emperor of Stonehall is seen by many of his people as a savior who brought them safety... to others he is a merciless conqueror that has destroyed their people's way of life. But no matter their position, everyone knows better than to publically question his authority. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10226.name: Wingfall Hammer

10226.lore: The All Seeing One anointed this hammer, giving its wielder the strength to bolster their allies and crush their enemies. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10230.name: Ristul Emblem

+2 Armor

10230.lore: To those willing to step into a world of Demonic etiquette and politics, the Court of Ristul is willing to offer considerable power... for a price. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

10238.name: Claymore

To these men and women, there is no glory greater than claiming the horn of a Thunderhide Alpha for their own. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

Some might frown at my attempted murder, but if I never developed these drones, he never would have built his robot suit to hide in. So really, he should be thanking me. — Tinker, No Friend Of Mazzie

10293.lore: I've seen many hunters in my day. Each one bold. And strong. And fearless. Fearless that is, until they realize they're not the Apex Predator... and then they run like the cowards they are.— Beastmaster, Apex Predator

10294.name: Nethertoxin

10296.lore: I was nervous about following the Society of Likeminded Keenfolk to Roseleaf... Sniper had a lot of rules. Rules like 'we can't stop to cut down every tree'. But when he saw the Treants marching towards us, he quickly made an exception. — Timbersaw, Crazed Lumberjack

10299.name: Defend the Weak

Enchant Unit

10299.lore: Ilexa has no idea how important she will be in the days to come. She must be protected at all costs. — Magnus to the Prowlers

10303.lore: It's the rule of nature: there is always something stronger and deadlier than you. Some people need to be reminded of that truth. — Magnus on Jungle Survival

10305.name: Raze
10305.lore: Sometimes I think Sniper doesn't really want to be my friend, he just wants me on his side so I won't destroy everything he loves. — Timbersaw, Paranoid Keen

10306.name: Smash Their Defenses!

Dispel a tower enchantment.
Draw a card.
10306.lore: Everyone likes to think they build things that last, but if you give the Keen enough time, we'll figure out how to destroy anything. — Timbersaw, Founding Member of the S.O.L.K.

10307.name: Foresight
10307.lore: The Oracle claims to see every eventuality; if true such a man could be a powerful ally... or at the very least a foe worth testing myself against. — Dark Seer ponders the future

10310.name: Oglodi Catapult
10310.lore: The Bronze Legion weren't supposed be in Roseleaf, but it doesn't matter... we were going to have to face them eventually. On one hand it's a shame. A warrior like Tresdin deserves more than dying in some backwater vhoul city. On the other, perhaps it is a mercy that she will be spared from seeing her beloved city burn. — Vreth, Oglodi Artillerist

10311.name: Arm the Rebellion
10311.text_plain: Give your creeps +2 Attack and +1 Armor permanently.
10311.lore: I'll never forget the first day of the rebellion. Tresdin sent me to collect rations from the farmers of Roseleaf... supplies in case the Red Mist siege would be prolonged... but it was a lean year for those farmers. I reported what they could spare, but Tresdin decided it wasn't enough, and so she instructed her thugs to take what they needed by force...after all, 'it was for their own good.' Well when her people arrived they didn't find cowering farmers. They found an army that I will lead until my dying day. The men, women and pups of Roseleaf deserve to live their lives free of Stonehall's grip. And while the price of their freedom will be blood, it is a price we are all willing to pay. — Rix, Rabble-Rouser

10315.name: Annihilation

voice_lines.assassins_apprentice_ancient_both_01: I won't fail in my mission.
voice_lines.assassins_apprentice_hero_friend_02: Its an honor to learn from the best...
voice_lines.beastmaster_arrogant_10: At least I'm honest about my hatred of people.
voice_lines.beastmaster_concerned_03: This requires a delicate hand. I'm bad at delicate things.
voice_lines.beastmaster_enigmatic_03: Its impossible not to be humbled by this place...
voice_lines.bloodseeker_angry_06: You have no idea who you're dealing with...
voice_lines.bloodseeker_arrogant_08: Not an ideal sacrifice, but I'll take what I can get.
voice_lines.bloodseeker_concerned_06: Is this to be my fate...
voice_lines.bloodseeker_single_target_damage_10: Offer your throat and save us all some time...
voice_lines.bristleback_kill_rival_05: I'm gonna punch your face in.
voice_lines.bristleback_potential_kill_05: At least you made me work for it.
voice_lines.bristleback_taunt_generic_02: Come on people, I'm lookin' for a challenge...
voice_lines.bristleback_unique_05: I could do this all day...
voice_lines.centaur_warrunner_angry_07: When I'm through with you there will be nothing left to bury...
voice_lines.centaur_warrunner_arrogant_05: My clan has no warriors as pathetic as you.
voice_lines.centaur_warrunner_enigmatic_06: There's a way around any problem...
voice_lines.chen_arrogant_02: Once I was like you... pathetic.
voice_lines.chen_concerned_09: This is just another tribulation I must weather...
voice_lines.crystal_maiden_permanent_health_05: It's not blind optimism when you can back it up.
voice_lines.crystal_maiden_unique_06: Well this was inevitable wasn't it.
voice_lines.cursed_satyr_tower_destroy_04: We must hurry and end this!
voice_lines.cursed_satyr_tower_destroy_05: I won't be ruled by fear.
voice_lines.cursed_satyr_tower_saved_03: I want my death to mean something.
voice_lines.dark_seer_permanent_armor_05: It's all part of my plan.
voice_lines.dark_seer_taunt_generic_06: I'm the greatest military mind in generations.
voice_lines.disciple_of_nevermore_ancient_both_01: We'll end this once and for all.
voice_lines.disciple_of_nevermore_unique_01: Do I have a deal for you.
voice_lines.drow_ranger_angry_07: That's the last mistake you'll make!
voice_lines.drow_ranger_angry_09: I'm going to take my time with you...
voice_lines.drow_ranger_arrogant_06: I thought there was going to be a challenge...
voice_lines.drow_ranger_concerned_04: This isn't exactly how I planned this going...
voice_lines.drow_ranger_enigmatic_09: Trust me, you're getting off easy.
voice_lines.earthshaker_arrogant_07: There's no shame in admitting you're outmatched...
voice_lines.earthshaker_concerned_04: We can pull this off... I think...
voice_lines.earthshaker_enigmatic_06: You're about to behold something wondrous and terrible...
voice_lines.earthshaker_enigmatic_08: That drum you hear is the sound of your undoing...
voice_lines.emissary_tower_destroy_04: I've come to accelerate the inevitable.
voice_lines.emissary_tower_saved_01: This battle is far from over.
voice_lines.emissary_tower_saved_03: The tide is beginning to turn.
voice_lines.enchantress_arrogant_05: You're not half as clever as you think you are...
voice_lines.enchantress_arrogant_09: You never really had a chance....
voice_lines.enchantress_concerned_10: It's getting hard to stay optimistic...
voice_lines.enchantress_enigmatic_04: Perhaps some good will come of this...
voice_lines.enchantress_pleased_08: I feel like singing, I mean I won't do it, but the sentiment remains...
voice_lines.legion_commander_cast_spell_03: I have you just where I want you.
voice_lines.legion_commander_kill_rival_08: It was over before it began.
voice_lines.legion_commander_kill_rival_09: You can't fight a superior force.
voice_lines.legion_commander_taunt_generic_02: Bend the knee or be destroyed!
voice_lines.lich_angry_06: You will regret ever coming here...
voice_lines.lich_enigmatic_08: I hope you've made peace with your deities…
voice_lines.luna_cast_spell_07: My power is not to be trifled with
voice_lines.luna_cast_spell_09: This war was over before it began.
voice_lines.luna_kill_rival_09: This isn't going well for you, is it?
voice_lines.luna_taunt_generic_08: Don't be cocky, the battle isn't over yet.
voice_lines.luna_unique_20: That's just a taste of what's to come...
voice_lines.lycan_potential_save_05: Better men have tried to kill me...
voice_lines.lycan_unique_07: Now is the time to strike!
voice_lines.marrowfell_brawler_ancient_attack_02: Our victory will make a fine story...
voice_lines.meepo_angry_06: You started it, but I’m gonna finish it...
voice_lines.meepo_arrogant_04: Who's better than me? Don't answer that.
voice_lines.meepo_concerned_04: THIS IS ALL YOUR FAULT MEEPO!
voice_lines.meepo_concerned_08: I have made some poor life choices, haven't I...
voice_lines.meepo_enigmatic_04: This is gonna blow your fragile mind.
voice_lines.meepo_enigmatic_10: Maybe next time you'll take me more seriously....
voice_lines.mercenary_exiles_hero_rival_03: You barbarians don’t have a chance against trained soldiers...
voice_lines.necrophos_arrogant_04: I wish you could see the look on your face...
voice_lines.necrophos_arrogant_08: I was hoping you'd be a challenge. Pity.
voice_lines.necrophos_concerned_03: This isn't going as I planned...
voice_lines.necrophos_concerned_06: I won't let this be the end.
voice_lines.necrophos_pleased_09: Oh such wonderful things I have in store...
voice_lines.ogre_corpse_tosser_ancient_both_02: Hope you have lots of friends...
voice_lines.ogre_magi_angry_08: You think you're so smart Not as smart as us!
voice_lines.ogre_magi_arrogant_10: We may not be the strongest. But we're smarterest.
voice_lines.ogre_magi_concerned_06: If we stay calm we can survive this WE'RE GONNA DIE!
voice_lines.ogre_magi_enigmatic_06: Time to get creative... we're throwing a rock? No. Even better...
voice_lines.ogre_magi_enigmatic_10: If you don't think about anything, your enemy can never guess what you're thinking....
voice_lines.ogre_magi_pleased_08: I haven't felt this happy since we first started lighting people on fire...
voice_lines.omniknight_arrogant_10: With the All Seeing One on our side, we cannot lose!
voice_lines.omniknight_concerned_09: The odds are not in our favor...
voice_lines.omniknight_enigmatic_02: Death holds no power over me...
voice_lines.phantom_assassin_cast_spell_06: I don't know why you were chosen, just that you must die.
voice_lines.phantom_assassin_kill_rival_06: No one is beyond my reach.
voice_lines.phantom_assassin_permanent_attack_05: I'm ready for the next name on my list.
voice_lines.phantom_assassin_potential_save_03: You'll have to try better than that...
voice_lines.pugna_angry_01: I HAVE NOT LOST CONTROL! I AM CONTROL!
voice_lines.pugna_angry_03: I'll kill you! Burn you! Hurt you! Break you!
voice_lines.quoidge_pugilist_ancient_attack_02: This'll be over in no time...
voice_lines.quoidge_pugilist_ancient_protect_02: We're not outta the fight yet...
voice_lines.ravenhook_ancient_attack_01: Don't worry, it'll all be over soon.
voice_lines.ravenhook_ancient_both_02: Oh I'm dyin' to see what happens next...
voice_lines.ravenhook_summon_03: Let's get this nasty business over with, shall we?
voice_lines.rebel_decoy_use_ability_03: If I'm lucky I'll survive this.
voice_lines.red_mist_pillager_ancient_attack_02: This is going to be too easy....
voice_lines.red_mist_pillager_ancient_protect_01: There will be more of us in no time...
voice_lines.red_mist_pillager_hero_friend_02: With you leading us, we cannot fail.
voice_lines.red_mist_pillager_summon_02: This is ours for the taking...
voice_lines.revtel_convoy_ancient_attack_02: This business will be over soon.
voice_lines.revtel_convoy_unique_02: You will let us pass or you will die.
voice_lines.rix_kill_rival_04: We will never bend the knee!
voice_lines.rix_kill_rival_08: I don't fear death. You on the other hand...
voice_lines.roseleaf_rejuvinator_ancient_both_02: This place is under my protection!
voice_lines.roseleaf_rejuvinator_hero_friend_03: Time to deal with these interlopers.
voice_lines.satyr_magician_tower_destroy_02: For my next trick, I'll make your tower disappear.
voice_lines.satyr_magician_tower_destroy_05: You put up a noble fight, but I'm afraid it's over.
voice_lines.satyr_magician_unique_07: How do you still have options?
voice_lines.selfish_cleric_tower_saved_01: I can do this all day.
voice_lines.selfish_cleric_tower_saved_05: I'll fight till my dying breath.
voice_lines.selfish_cleric_unique_07: I know you'll be dead soon, but don't worry I'll be ok.
voice_lines.sis_o_veil_tower_destroy_04: My blade can taste the blood. My lips the victory.
voice_lines.skywrath_mage_angry_08: I will not suffer your arrogance!
voice_lines.skywrath_mage_arrogant_05: One day I'll find someone who is my equal...
voice_lines.skywrath_mage_arrogant_07: Today the Skywrath Mage graces you with his presence...
voice_lines.skywrath_mage_arrogant_09: Weak minds are so easy to deceive...
voice_lines.skywrath_mage_concerned_08: I know I was sent here to die, but I won't go without a fight.
voice_lines.skywrath_mage_concerned_10: If we don't change course soon, we are doomed to fail!
voice_lines.skywrath_mage_pleased_08: Naturally this is going according to plan.
voice_lines.smeevil_blacksmith_ancient_both_01: I will not fail you master.
voice_lines.sniper_arrogant_04: You think a marksman of my skill can be denied?
voice_lines.sniper_enigmatic_05: I have something special in store for you.
voice_lines.sniper_enigmatic_07: Perhaps you're not familiar with what the Keen are capable of.
voice_lines.sorla_khan_arrogant_02: What chance do you have against a Khan of the Red Mist.
voice_lines.sorla_khan_concerned_04: I will meet my death with courage.
voice_lines.sorla_khan_concerned_05: I will not bow to you.
voice_lines.stonehall_elite_ancient_attack_02: In time, only Stonehall will remain.
voice_lines.stonehall_elite_ancient_both_01: This is the moment of truth, isn't it.
voice_lines.stonehall_elite_unique_02: You brought this on your self.
voice_lines.storm_spirit_arrogant_05: At least you entertained me before you died...
voice_lines.storm_spirit_concerned_10: Fear is what makes life worth living...
voice_lines.storm_spirit_enigmatic_08: And in a flash... you're dead.
voice_lines.storm_spirit_enigmatic_09: You and I are going to have some fun, I can tell...
voice_lines.sven_angry_07: You face a knight of the Vigil!
voice_lines.sven_angry_10: You won't live long enough to regret your choices...
voice_lines.sven_arrogant_08: What idiot wishes to lose their life to Sven.
voice_lines.sven_concerned_05: I will not back down, no matter the odds.
voice_lines.sven_concerned_10: This is but a temporary setback....
voice_lines.sven_enigmatic_01: I will live to get revenge...
voice_lines.sven_enigmatic_08: You aren't ready for what I have in store for you...
voice_lines.timbersaw_arrogant_10: You honestly think you can win, don't you?
voice_lines.timbersaw_enigmatic_01: Oh you won't be laughing for long...
voice_lines.timbersaw_enigmatic_02: I have something special for you...
voice_lines.timbersaw_enigmatic_05: I have a lot of surprises in store for you...
voice_lines.tinker_arrogant_02: I'm the greatest Keenfolk mind in a generation...
voice_lines.tinker_arrogant_04: Congratulations! You provided me with the tools of your own destruction...
voice_lines.tinker_concerned_06: The odds of me surviving seem...poor...
voice_lines.tinker_concerned_10: There's a solution here... I just need to find it...
voice_lines.treant_protector_angry_05: Test your strength against me, and discover your limits.
voice_lines.treant_protector_arrogant_04: A lesser creature like you has no chance against me...
voice_lines.treant_protector_concerned_01: I can't give in to despair.
voice_lines.treant_protector_multi_damage_large_10: The world will go on without you. Emptier, but richer.
voice_lines.troll_soothsayer_ancient_attack_02: I see victory in our future...
voice_lines.troll_soothsayer_ancient_both_02: We are being tested by the gods... we must not fail.
voice_lines.tyler_estate_censor_ancient_attack_01: Your Ancient's power isn't strong enough to save you!
voice_lines.tyler_estate_censor_ancient_both_02: I'll keep this from getting out of hand.
voice_lines.untested_grunt_ancient_both_01: It all comes down to this...
voice_lines.untested_grunt_hero_rival_02: ohhh what have I gotten into...
voice_lines.ursa_angry_02: Angering me was the last mistake you'll make!
voice_lines.ursa_arrogant_02: It's an honor to be killed by my hand.
voice_lines.ursa_arrogant_03: You weren't ready to face me.
voice_lines.ursa_concerned_06: I've brought shame to my people...
voice_lines.ursa_concerned_08: My pride got the better of me...
voice_lines.ursa_enigmatic_08: The river brings us food, drink, and a means to wash off blood.
voice_lines.vhoul_martyr_ancient_both_01: We all must be willing to give everything for our people...
voice_lines.vhoul_martyr_ancient_protect_01: I will not die in vain.
voice_lines.winter_wyvern_arrogant_06: I dictate the terms of battle...
voice_lines.winter_wyvern_concerned_07: Maybe I shouldn't have taken them so lightly...
voice_lines.winter_wyvern_enigmatic_03: I should write a book about this...
voice_lines.zeus_arrogant_05: Be glad. Today is the day you get to be murdered by Zeus.
voice_lines.zeus_arrogant_06: It is an honor to be smited by me personally.
voice_lines.zeus_arrogant_10: Ahhh the stupid optimism of mortals...
voice_lines.zeus_concerned_07: Hm, it seems I underestimated you...
voice_lines.zeus_concerned_08: Well you're certainly putting up a fight, aren't you...
voice_lines.zeus_enigmatic_02: I do what I want, when I want...
